claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Fluspirilene is a cationic amphiphilic diphenylbutylpiperidine that at 2.5 uM for 5 days most plausibly kills cells through lysosomal/phospholipidosis-type cationic amphiphilic drug stress rather than through dopamine receptor antagonism, producing a broad but somewhat selective antiproliferative pattern.
